answer: Require every agent that wants to emit a trusted signal to lock a bond that is forfeited if its vote backs a false consensus, the way timber must be paid for before it can hold up a roof. Because each identity is weighted by its own staked collateral, splitting into many Sybil names never multiplies influence: the attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake account, so the bill grows with each alias. By dawn the cost of faking a majority outweighs any loot it could steal, and honest agents keep the payoff.
